# Avery Dennison® Debuts Rehlm™ Architectural Finishes Portfolio, Introduces New, Public e-Commerce Website


## – New direct-to-installer platform marks first time film installation professionals can purchase these products directly online –


MENTOR, Ohio – September 2, 2026 – Avery Dennison® (NYSE:AVY) Graphics Solutions today debuted[Rehlm™ Architectural Finishes](https://shop.graphics.averydennison.com/) , a portfolio of textured, patterned films crafted to transform interior spaces. Rehlm Architectural Finishes are available to purchase on Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions' newly launched e-commerce platform –[https://shop.graphics.averydennison.com](https://shop.graphics.averydennison.com/) – the division’s first public online store giving installers the ability to purchase products directly from the company.


“Installers have 24/7 access to real-time pricing and online ordering through our[new public e-commerce website](https://shop.graphics.averydennison.com/) ,” said Alexandra Wixted, Architecture Segment Leader, Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions. “The mobile-optimized site provides an easy search function, quick ordering with no minimum order quantities, design inspiration and comprehensive resources for this innovative new product line.”


The new Rehlm™ Architectural Finishes by Avery Dennison are a portfolio of textured, patterned films crafted to transform interior spaces. The beautiful woodgrain in Bourbon Maple is ideal for updating hospitality settings where a woodgrain finish would make an immediate impact.


Installers can purchase exactly the film specs they need directly. Rehlm films open up new profit centers for installers with interior films for residential remodeling. Shown here is Grey Concrete, a color and texture that's extremely popular with homeowners for walls and countertop applications.


Engineered with installers in mind, the easy-to-apply Rehlm films offer 2D conformability and a built-in air egress liner that enables easy, bubble-free application and minimizes disruption during renovation projects. The films realistically capture the look and feel of several natural materials, including marble, metal, wood and more.


Suitable for application on smooth and simple curved surfaces, the durable and cost-effective films are recommended for a wide variety of industries including hospitality, healthcare, commercial, residential and retail.


Stone always makes a style statement. Shown here in this retail environment is the new Rehlm Architectural Finishes film in Buff Limestone.


The Rehlm portfolio of beautifully realistic textured films is a game-changer for anyone who wants to creatively upgrade interior spaces with durable, cost-effective solutions. These restored restaurant tabletops feature Rehlm in Gemma Terrazzo.


With a broad range of patterns and texture dimensions, the Rehlm portfolio brings surfaces to life with luxurious finishes for walls, doors, cabinets, columns, elevators and other flat surfaces. What sets the portfolio apart is the four texture levels available for every pattern in the portfolio. Installers have the option to choose from Smooth, Subtle, Defined or Elevated textures to give the look and feel desired for their design project.


“With the premiere of Rehlm Architectural Finishes, Avery Dennison is again innovating the industry,” said Wixted. “This portfolio of beautifully realistic textured films is a game-changer for anyone who wants to creatively upgrade interior spaces with durable, cost-effective solutions.”


Rehlm Architectural Finishes are constructed from scuff-resistant, flexible, white vinyl pressure-sensitive film. Featuring a matte finish with 100% opacity, the line offers durability of up to 10 years for vertical and up to five years for horizontal interior installations.


For more information about Rehlm Architectural Finishes, visit[https://shop.graphics.averydennison.com](https://shop.graphics.averydennison.com/) .
